DV17 Basic Tech to fit, permanent; not for Popup Shields. Two mounts (10 minutes each, items bought separately) for a cyberscanner, flashlight, handheld audio or video gear (camera, recorder, radio scanner, communicator, speakers, amplifier), radar detector, small storage (not a carryall) or an umbrella. They only work while the shield has HP and is in use, and they're lost with it.

Item Compendium (2070) • Armor & Shields
